cases.name: 1. mail: sealed OTP job claimed, opened, delivered, payload sealed
cases.details: Job enqueued with AES-256-GCM sealed payload via HKDF-SHA256 key; claimed, opened, and delivered via sendOtp; completed with state='sent' and payload sealed to NULL.

cases.name: 2. mail: each documented kind routes to its transport method and terminal rows are sealed
cases.details: Routes kinds 'otp'->sendOtp, 'changed'->sendPasswordChanged, 'security'->sendSecurityNotice, and 'mail'->sendMail with decrypted payloads; all completed terminal rows are sealed.

cases.name: 3. logging: no OTP, secret, address or ciphertext ever reaches the log
cases.details: Exercised mail delivery and logged events; verified that OTP codes, recipient addresses, mail secrets, and ciphertext never leak into any log record.

cases.name: 4. restart: job enqueued before a restart is claimed and delivered by the new worker
cases.details: Core restart simulation: job enqueued before process restart survives and is picked up by a fresh worker instance, delivered, and sealed without dropping.

cases.name: 5. privacy: cancellation supersedes the deleting actor's jobs and seals them
cases.details: cancelActorOutbox supersedes pending queued and in-flight sending jobs for the deleted actor and seals payloads to NULL, while control actor jobs are untouched.

cases.name: 6. retention: old terminal rows and expired buckets are purged, active and recent rows survive
cases.details: purgeExpiredRetention removes terminal rows older than 7 days while preserving active and recent jobs; purgeExpiredRateBuckets cleans expired rate limits.

cases.name: 7. worker app: start arms a real interval, tick drains the extracted work, stop() silences it
cases.details: createWorkerApp orchestrates periodic ticks via setInterval; tick processes mail, expires due jobs, and runs retention cleanup; stop() disarms interval cleanly.

verification.summary: Email outbox, notifications, cleanup and approved privacy/deletion workflows extracted out of the game process into apps/worker and packages/services/worker-workflows.js. AES-256-GCM encryption preserved; zero OTP/secret log leakage verified; Core restart job survival proven; privacy cancellation and retention cleanup verified across 7 dedicated tests on real PG16.
